note: The full ninety-day slate. Built components live in their own folders; these are the scheduled remainder. Three per type across all ten permitted labels, so no two submissions collide.

components.name: Morph Action Button
components.summary: One control that morphs through idle, working and done without changing size or losing its label.

components.name: Sortable Data Table
components.summary: Column sorting with correct aria-sort, numeric and date comparators, and a stable sort so equal rows keep their order.

components.name: Inline Validation Form
components.summary: Validates on blur rather than on keystroke, reports errors through aria-describedby, and never moves focus out from under the user.

components.name: Progress Ring
components.summary: A determinate SVG ring driven by stroke-dashoffset, announcing progress to assistive technology without flooding it.

components.name: Sparkline Set
components.summary: Inline trend lines sized to the text around them, drawn from a data attribute, with an accessible table fallback.

components.name: Bottom Sheet
components.summary: A sheet that drags to dismiss with real momentum, snaps to detents, and traps focus while open.

components.name: Tag Combobox
components.summary: Free text plus suggestions, chips that delete backwards, and the full combobox ARIA pattern.

components.name: Breadcrumb Trail
components.summary: Collapses the middle of a deep path into an overflow menu rather than truncating with an ellipsis.

components.name: Flip Spec Card
components.summary: Two faces in one footprint, flipped by pointer or keyboard, with the hidden face removed from the tab order.

components.name: Sticky Stack
components.summary: Panels that stack and scale as they pin, driven entirely by scroll timelines on their own container.

components.name: Hold to Confirm
components.summary: A destructive action that requires a sustained press, with a progress fill and a keyboard equivalent that is not a trap.

components.name: Sticky Header Table
components.summary: Header and first column both pinned, with correct shadowing at the intersection and no layout shift on scroll.

components.name: Multi-step Form
components.summary: Progress that survives a reload, back navigation that does not lose entered values, and one error summary per step.

components.name: Radial Gauge
components.summary: A single value on an arc with tick marks, a threshold band, and a readable value at every size.

components.name: Staged Pipeline
components.summary: Sequential stages that resolve independently, with failures shown in place rather than replacing the whole component.

components.name: Range Scrubber
components.summary: A two-handle range with keyboard steps, collision handling between thumbs, and a live value readout.

components.name: Confirm Dialog
components.summary: The destructive-action dialog done properly: focus on the safe option, escape to cancel, and the reason stated before the buttons.

components.name: Sidebar Rail
components.summary: Collapses to icons with accessible names retained, remembers its state, and never hides the current page.

components.name: Stacked Deck
components.summary: A deck that fans on hover and deals on click, with the depth built from transforms rather than stacked shadows.

components.name: Comparison Slider
components.summary: A before-and-after wipe driven by pointer and arrow keys, with both images described independently.

components.name: Split Menu Button
components.summary: A primary action beside its own menu, with roving focus and the menu closing on outside pointer and Escape alike.

components.name: Expandable Rows
components.summary: Detail rows that expand without breaking column alignment, with correct aria-expanded and aria-controls.

components.name: Filter Panel
components.summary: Faceted filters that write to the URL, restore from it, and report how many results each facet would leave.

components.name: Stacked Bars
components.summary: Series stacked with readable labels at small sizes, a legend that doubles as a series toggle, and a data table behind it.

components.name: Optimistic Row
components.summary: A row that appears before the server confirms it and rolls back visibly when the write fails.
